products.title: The Pillars of Defense: Leg Locks to Guard Passing by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Systematically Defend Leglocks Directly Into High-Percentage Passing With Gordon Ryan’s Latest Installment of The Pillars Of Defense Series!
  • Learn to not only defend leg locks from a wide range of entanglements, but also consistently pass your opponent’s guard from their failed leg attacks.
  • Develop both defensive and offensive strategies from the most commonly used leg entanglements including irimi ashi, outside ashi, cross ashi, 50/50, and more!
  • Build confidence in your ability to consistently defend leglocks even from the deepest and best leg entanglements.
  • Deal with tricky inversions with consistent methods of v-grips, tight waists, and body locks that Gordon has used at the highest levels of the sport.
  • Gordon breaks down rolling footage to show real world examples of the techniques as well as troubleshoot common leg lock tactics.
  • Know More. Win More.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

Systematically Defend Leglocks Directly Into High-Percentage Passing With Gordon Ryan’s Latest Installment of The Pillars Of Defense Series!

     Check Out Sample!

    What Will You Learn?

    In the latest installment of the Pillars Of Defense series, Gordon Ryan sets his sights on defending leg locks and using those situations to secure high-percentage guard passes. This 8-part series is packed full of the latest and greatest strategies on dealing with the most used leg entanglements, and going from defensive cycles to offensive ones. Whether you are a beginner looking to understand the leg game early on, or a long-time vet looking to upgrade your leg lock defense, this series is for you!

    Gordon Ryan is not only one of the best competitors of all-time, he has a teaching ability to match! That ability is on full display through the 8-part series. Understand each phase of your opponent’s offense as Gordon breaks down how to unwrap and unwind today’s trickiest leg entanglements. Systematically defend and defeat irimi ashi, outside ashi, cross ashi, 50/50, top ushiro, and more!

    The key to successfully defending today’s modern leg attacks is to break the cycle from being on defense and to go on offense. Gordon teaches how to do this from each entanglement. On top of that you will learn some of Gordon’s best passing sequences. Learn to punish every leg attack with brutal body locks, leg drags, tripod passing, among other high level passes.

    The Pillars Of Defense Leg Locks to Guard Passing series is a must-have for ANY grappler looking to learn from the best in the game, Gordon Ryan! Defend against the even the toughest leg lockers with confidence and know once you are out, you can stay out, with high-percentage guard passes that Gordon has used to win at the highest level of the sport!

products.title: Systematically Attacking The Guillotine by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Gordon Ryan won an ADCC title by way of guillotine and he is here to show you the guillotine like never before. Start understanding this famous choke as more than a submission but as a position from the greatest no gi grappler ever

  • The guillotine may be the most accessible and high percentage submission in no gi - And it is much more than a submission
  • Learn how to use the guillotine to sweep, submit, pass, pin and MORE
  • Until Now This System Was Only For Gordon and his team but Gordon is going to share every single detail throughout 8 volumes and include rolling commentary where he goes over his EXACT train of thought
  • Gordon is not only the greatest no gi grappler but a master of articulation - he breaks techniques down in an EASY to implement way
  • Know more win more



Check Out A Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Unlock the secrets to dominating with the guillotine choke in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Gordon Ryan's comprehensive instructional video, Systematically Attacking The Guillotine. Gordon won an ADCC title by guillotine - He is a master. 

  • Learn from a BJJ Phenom: Gordon Ryan, hailed as the greatest no gi grappler ever with the highest submission rate in history- Gordon boasts an impressive record including multiple ADCC championships, where he has showcased his mastery over opponents worldwide.

  • Guided by John Danaher: Trained under the guidance of legendary coach John Danaher, known for his systematic approach to grappling and creating top level athletes, Gordon Ryan's techniques are refined and cutting-edge with EXTREME attention to detail and excellent articulation

  • Step-by-Step Instruction: Gordon breaks down setups, grips, and finishing mechanics, ensuring you grasp each detail with clarity and depth.

  • Versatile Applications: Whether you're standing, in guard, or transitioning between positions, Gordon Ryan teaches you how to apply the guillotine effectively against opponents of all sizes and styles.

  • Advanced Strategies: Gain insights into troubleshooting common mistakes and countering opponent defenses effectively, enhancing your tactical awareness on the mats.

Who Is This For?

Perfect for practitioners at any skill level, from beginners to seasoned competitors, Gordon Ryan's "Systematically Attacking The Guillotine" not only teaches a potent submission but also embodies the essence of high-level Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu by demonstrating the guillotine as more than a submission but as a position. 

Learn how to use this positon to pass, sweep, submit anyone. The neck is more available than ANYTHING in no gi and so many people are neglecting it. GORDON WON AN ADCC TITLE BY GUILLOTINE.

products.title: They Shall Not Pass by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Stop getting your guard passed with these retention systems from Gordon “The King” Ryan, as he shows you his method for never giving up bad positions!
  • Gordon Ryan is the ADCC Absolute Champion and one of the best no-gi grapplers of all time, and the consensus best active no-gi grappler competing today.
  • Totally understand your goals and major questions from each position, including against some of grappling’s most common passes.
  • Stop passes like knee cuts, torreando, stacking, and more with this 8-volume technical instructional.
  • Go into Gordon’s system with him as he narrates gym footage of him using his guard retention live, so you can see the technique in action.
  • Learn the most effective ways to retain guard in some of grappling’s most reliable positions, including X guard, half guard, seated guard, and more.


Never Get Your Guard Passed Again And Start Turning The Tables With Gordon “The King” Ryan’s 8-Volume Guide To Systematically Retaining Your Guard And Getting Back On Offense !

 

 Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

 Start winning off your back by mastering one of grappling’s most difficult and tricky skills with Gordon Ryan’s 8-volume master class in retaining your guard. Stop giving up easy guard passes and start turning their attacks into your own offense with Gordon’s dilemmas, guidelines, and techniques for success.

Once you can stop guard passers in their tracks, your bottom guard can reach its potential as you can attack safely. Now, across 8-volumes, you can learn from the best no-gi grappler on Earth as he shows you how he never gets his guard passed and what you can do to start mastering this skill.

Take common and effective passes in grappling like the stack pass, the torreando, the split squat, body lock, and more and totally break them down with Gordon’s help, as he explains the concepts and combinations you’ll need. You can also learn how to retain and defend from offensive positions like X guard, ashi garami, half guard, seated guard, and more.

Go into Gordon’s system with him as he narrates gym footage of him using his guard retention live, so you can see the technique in action. Gordon takes on five opponents in the gym as they try to pass his guard, and he narrates over the footage and breaks down exactly what’s he doing step-by-step,so your guard never gets passed again.

products.body:
This is your chance to learn from 3-Time ADCC Champion Gordon Ryan as he shares all his competition secrets around the body lock

  • Gordon is one of the most detailed and thorough teachers in grappling, with incredible systematic attention to detail.
  • Use front body locks, side body locks, tightwaists, over under body locks, and more to smash through the guard using Gordon’s advice.
  • Learn what the “Golden Trilemma” is - and how you can use it to create an unstoppable passing threat.
  • These are the same systems that Gordon uses to pass against elite competition, including leg pummeling, half guard passing, high tripods, and more.
  • Watch as Gordon rolls in the gym from these same systems and then breaks down the footage to explain the techniques in action.

Get A Lock On Your Opponent And Shut Down Their Guard With Gordon Ryan’s 10-Volume Study Of The Body Lock - With Every Technique, Strategy, & System You Need To Succeed With This No-Gi Grappling Passing Attack!


Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Break down the art and science of body lock guard passing with Gordon “The King” Ryan as he shows how to use this effective system to shut down and dominate bottom players in no-gi grappling. With 10 volumes packed with instructional content and rolling breakdowns, this series shows every detail of Gordon’s system for using body locks successfully at the highest levels of the spot.

Gordon Ryan is one of the best no-gi grapplers in history, and is still building his legacy with a path of submission success. With 3 ADCC World Championships & an IBJJF World No-Gi Championship, he has charted a path of success built on technical precision and strategic strength - with body lock passing as one of the keys to his next level guard passing. Now you can learn how to enter the body lock, when and how to use them, and how to systematically work through the guard using these techniques for passing success.

Combine body locks from the side, front, outside, and more positions to create strong passing attacks as you see the cues for entering and moving between each. Split the legs and force your way into half guard passing, high tripod passing, leg pummeling, and more strong sub-systems that Gordon breaks down - including the “Golden Trilemma” that will change the way you pressure pass in no-gi.

So, What Exactly Do You Get?
